scope: Theorem 3.1 (Negative interval unit) of the manuscript “Purely cosmetic surgery on knots in the three-sphere” (preprints/Purely-Cosmetic-Surgery-on-Knots-in-the-Three-Sphere-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 306 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ee916c92b825a868), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The counts defining B can be chosen coherently so that B : C(Y2; Z) −→ C(Y−2; Z) is an integral chain map. Its reduction modulo two induces an isomorphism on Floer homology. Its integral chain-homotopy class is unchanged by compatible changes of the interval data and sphere sweep. The relative sign of the two determinant lifts is local at N′, is independent of the exterior solution, and is preserved under composition with other cobordisms.
